title: fix(plugin-grid): the import wizard spares a required field that carries a default
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTqSRkWmphyUSnApdf9ipxp)_

Fixes #28885

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:导入向导的映射步骤不再要求文件提供「必填但带默认值」的字段。字段声明了 `defaultValue`(静态值或表达式),或某个选项标了 `default: true`,未映射时视为已满足,值交给服务端写入时填默认;预览里该列的空单元格也不再标红。必填且无默认值的字段照旧拦住。向导只判断「有没有声明默认值」,从不求值表达式。
- 为什么改:duly 的 `review_status` 必填、带按记录计算的 CEL 默认值,不带该列的样例文件在 18.2 卡在「Can't continue — required field(s) not mapped」,17.2 能导入 19 行。实测服务端导入对缺列与空单元格都会填默认值,向导问的问题与引擎答的不一致。
- 风险与回滚:向导字段类型多了两个可选键(`defaultValue`、选项上的 `default`),控制台两个宿主(对象列表的导入、AI 聊天的表格导入)把字段的 `defaultValue` 原样传入。已知边界:表达式默认值读到的键本行也没给时(如 `record.source` 缺失),服务端逐行以 `required` 拒收,向导不预判。回滚即还原本 PR,无数据或协议变更。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`(`importFillsDefault` / `importRequiresValue` 及其三处调用)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/importTargetFields.ts`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ExcelImportBar.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.requiredDefault.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/importTargetFields.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `ImportWizard.tsx`:** one presence-only predicate, `importFillsDefault(field)`: a declared `defaultValue` (`null` and absent declare none; an expression counts, whatever it reads), else an option marked `default: true` that carries a value. That is what the engine's insert defaulting reads (`applyFieldDefaults`, then `resolveOptionDefault` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`). `importRequiresValue(field)` is `required` and no default. It gates three places that asked `field.required` before:
  - the mapping step's missing-required list, so the hint and the held Next skip a defaulted field;
  - the mapping dropdown's required star;
  - the preview's blank-cell `required` refusal (`checkImportCell`), so a blank cell in a mapped defaulted column is not marked and its row is counted.
- The legacy per-row create path (used only when the server import route is unreachable) leaves a blank cell of a defaulted field out of the record, so the create fills the default instead of storing an empty string.
- `ImportWizardProps['fields']` gains an optional `defaultValue` (passed through as the object schema declares it) and its option objects an optional `default`.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`:** the wizard's two hosts pass the field's `defaultValue` through: `importTargetFields` (the object list's Import) and `ExcelImportBar`'s `normalizeFields` (the AI chat's spreadsheet import). Options already passed through raw.
- The wizard never evaluates an expression default.

## Why

The card's expected behaviour: the mapping step treats a required field that has a `defaultValue` (static or expression) as satisfied when unmapped, and leaves the value to the write path; a required field with no default still blocks. The wizard never saw defaults, because both hosts dropped `defaultValue` when they built its field list, so the fix needed the two producers too (claim amendment 2026-11-02T04:19Z widened the file surface to them).

## Tests

- Write path measured first, as the order asked, with a scratch probe (deleted, not committed) on the real `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` route over a sqlite `:memory:` engine (`packages/rest`, the `import-integration.test.ts` harness), at `origin/main` `9a9823d9`. Object `duty`: `review_status` required select with the reported CEL default `record.source == 'self' ? 'to_review' : 'to_confirm'`, `static_status` required with `defaultValue: 'open'`, `title` required with no default.
  - Column absent, JSON rows: dry run and commit both `ok`; stored `review_status` `to_review` for `source: self`, `to_confirm` for `source: assigned`; `static_status` `open`.
  - Column absent, CSV: 2 of 2 created, same stored values.
  - Blank and whitespace cells in a mapped `review_status` / `static_status` column: dry run and commit both `ok`, defaults stored.
  - Control: `title` missing is refused, `code: required`, `Title is required`.
  - Edge: a row that also omits `source` is refused as `required` on `review_status` (the expression reads a key the row does not carry), on the dry run and the commit alike.
- New `ImportWizard.requiredDefault.test.tsx` (6 cases): an unmapped required field with an expression default does not hold Next; nor a static default, nor an option marked default; a required field with no default is still named, and only it; a `null` defaultValue declares none; in the preview a blank cell in a defaulted required column is unmarked and its row counted (`Import 2 Rows`), while a blank cell with no default is still marked (`Import 1 Row`).
- `importTargetFields.test.ts`: a new case that a declared `defaultValue` (an expression envelope and a static value) passes through as declared, and none is set when it is absent or `null`.
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob (`git diff HEAD` empty):
  - missing-required list back to `f.required`: 3 of 6 red (the three mapping-step cases).
  - blank-cell arm back to `field.required`: 1 of 6 red (the defaulted blank cell).
- On the merged head `745445a4`: `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-grid` 50/50, and every plugin-grid import suite plus the two `ExcelImportBar` suites and `importTargetFields.test.ts`: 35 files, 307 tests passed.
- On `5e39a211` (before the merge of main, which touched none of these files): `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell` 65/65; `plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` green with the app-shell suites (4 files, 80 tests).

## Acceptance notes

- Known limit, named on the seat's instruction: an expression default that reads a key the row also omits (here `record.source` absent) is refused per row by the server as `required`. The wizard does not predict it; the dry run reports it per row.
- Not measured in a browser console; the jsdom suites drive the real wizard component.
